rationale: The first preregistered daily screen produced no C signals and therefore could not evaluate preregistered E/F. An exploratory diagnostic on A signals suggested linear weighting may recover faster/with lower path drawdown. This follow-up tests that hypothesis on untouched assets; the original OOS is not reused as confirmatory evidence.

evaluation_window.note: Earlier rows may be used only as indicator warm-up.

signal.definition: same A: long 3-Push from 2/2 confirmed price pivot lows with Wilder RSI14 rising across the three lower price lows
signal.action_anchor: next available daily close after confirmation

descriptive_context_only.note: These are subgroup diagnostics, not trade filters in this follow-up.

primary_comparisons: linear vs equal recovery rate within 30 days
linear vs equal median and worst diagnostic mark-to-market drawdown
linear vs equal final-step unrecovered rate
anti_overfit: No parameter changes after reading these asset files.
If fewer than 20 eligible signals exist, label the follow-up insufficient rather than relax the rules.
Daily close path diagnostics are not executable DEX fills or profitability proof.
